headline: A tour-shaped swing — the measurements mostly sit inside the pro bands.

sections.title: What lined up well
sections.body: Inside the typical tour spread: how far the hips rotate at the top, how much the upper body leans at setup, how much the upper body leans at impact, how much the spine angle changes from setup to impact, how much the head moves up and down, how much the hips slide toward the target.

sections.title: Worth a look
sections.body: Your how far the shoulders rotate at the top measured more than most tour swings. Your the gap between shoulder turn and hip turn at the top measured more than most tour swings. Your how open the hips are at impact measured more than most tour swings. Your how much the head drifts sideways measured less than most tour swings.

sections.title: Coach's read
sections.body:
At address, the setup position just before the swing starts, your upper body leaned about as much as a typical tour swing. At the top, where the club changes direction, your hips rotated about as far as a typical tour swing. Your tempo, the timing and rhythm of the swing, was close to the tour-typical pace. Your head stayed about as steady in height as a typical tour swing.

At the top, your shoulders rotated further than most tour swings. At the top, there was more difference between shoulder turn and hip turn than in most tour swings. At impact, the instant the club meets the ball, your hips were rotated more toward the target than most tour swings. Your head moved less side-to-side than most tour swings. Your lead knee, the knee closer to the target, was more bent at setup than most tour swings. At impact, the lead knee was straighter than most tour swings.

At impact, your upper body leaned about as much as a typical tour swing. From setup to impact, that upper body lean changed about as much as a typical tour swing. Your hips slid toward the target about as much as a typical tour swing. There is a lot here to feel good about.

sections.title: How to read this
sections.body: Every number here is measured from your video against a 400-swing tour reference — nothing is estimated by the AI. Ask the coach about any metric for the full story.
